semiconductor_relevance: High — Hoken High Tech Material specializes in advanced graphite materials used in semiconductor applications.
summary: Hoken High Tech Material (Ningxia) Co., Ltd. is a high-tech enterprise focused on the R&D, production, and sales of isostatically pressed graphite materials, particularly for semiconductor applications. Their products are utilized in various sectors including photovoltaics and military, with a significant production capacity and international expansion efforts.
capabilities: Third-generation SiC semiconductor series graphite (HK330, HK550, HK660, HK680, HK690)

regional_presence.China: The company has major production bases in Jiangsu and Ningxia, with a total production capacity of 30,000 tons.
regional_presence.Korea: Hoken has established a joint venture in South Korea to enhance cooperation in the semiconductor field.
